en: A vintage monochrome view of an Italian city square dominated by an ornate baroque fountain in the center, surrounded by multi‑story historic buildings with arcades and shuttered windows. On the right is a domed building, and people can be seen walking in the background. Printed captions at the bottom identify the location as Trento and describe the square and fountain.
